integrity: Exact formal-series and bijective results, with scope and access limits disclosed. No authorship or independent assessment is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Applies to simple cycle prisms with n>=3. The exact enumerator counts all dissociation sets, not only maximal sets. This is a mathematical proof with reproducible finite checks; independent validation is not claimed. A relevant 2024 maximal-dissociation paper was not available in full text, leaving residual literature-priority risk.
title: Complete dissociation polynomial and Lucas maximum-set law for cycle prisms
